_comment: B4 and B6 - mutation score. §5.13: the engine has existed since G5 and nothing
has ever mutated it, so this instrument is overdue rather than pending.
THE FIRST READING WAS 9.66% AND THAT WAS THE HARNESS, NOT THE CODE - exactly as
B3 read 57.73% before the golden vectors were visible to it. Stryker's vitest
runner has to see the WHOLE suite, including the 63 vectors, or every mutant is
judged by a handful of unit tests that were never meant to cover the engine.
No vitest config file is named, deliberately: this repo has none, so the runner
takes the root and discovers every *.spec.ts - which is what plain `npx vitest
run` does, and therefore what the score should mean.
thresholds.break is null ON PURPOSE. B4's 90% and B6's 75% live in BENCHMARKS.md,
which is frozen. Restating a threshold here would create a second copy that can
drift from the locked one, and the lock exists precisely to stop that.
